$comment: Stage = 5 waves, the 5th is always a boss. waveIndex is cumulative across stages, so stage 3 wave 3 is waveIndex 12 and feeds the enemy HP formula directly.
$authoring: Every wave is generated by core/rules.ts from the parameters below. Hand-written waves were the sole source of the difficulty cliffs the Phase 5 simulator found: total wave HP grows at exactly hpGrowthPerWave when the enemy counts are steady, and every >30% ratio drop traced back to a composition that jumped. Tune the ramp here, then re-run `npm run sim`.

procedural.$modifierCycle: Waves 1-5 keep the original tutorial order, then the full rotation.
procedural.$groups: startWave delays a type's debut. shielded is last because it takes zero damage from tier <= 3, which a new player cannot answer.
procedural.$bossWaveFillRatio: Boss waves carry the normal groups at this share as well. Without it a boss wave weighed about half its neighbours, and the wave after it spiked 152%.
